t.p: Middle Ages (tanning, scented gloves) to present
t.d: The Provençal town that grew from glove tanning into the centre of French perfume raw materials and manufacture.
t.tech: cold enfleurage of dawn-picked flowers; essential oils, concretes, absolutes, resinoids and molecular distillation
t.mat: jasmine (from the 16th century), rose, lavender, myrtle, orange blossom, mimosa
t.auth: Grasse-grown flower materials are scarce (under 30 tonnes of flowers a year by 2000), so origin claims need documentation.

t.d: Hydro-distillation of flowers, herbs and baked earth into a sandalwood base in copper stills; Kannauj perfumes hold a GI tag (2014).
t.tech: deg (copper still) sealed with clay, bamboo pipe to a bhapka of sandalwood oil, wood and cow-dung fire, repeated charges
t.mat: damask rose, jasmine, vetiver, kewra, baked clay, spices; sandalwood oil or liquid paraffin
t.auth: Kannauj GI tag; sandalwood rather than paraffin base; no alcohol; maker's distillery named

t.d: Wearing of dehn al oud, Taif rose oil, musk and blended mukhallat oils, traded by family houses in Gulf souqs.
t.tech: agarwood oil distillation; copper-pot distillation of Taif rose sold by the tola; blending into mukhallat
t.mat: agarwood (Aquilaria), Taif damask rose, white musk, amber, saffron
t.auth: origin and wood species stated; wild vs cultivated agarwood; natural oud oil yields are tiny, so cheap 'pure' oils are suspect

t.d: Interwar export trade in figural and cut perfume bottles drawing on centuries of Bohemian glassmaking.
t.tech: press-moulded stoppers, mould-blown bases, selective polishing, intaglio, enamelling, jewelled metal mounts
t.auth: 'Made in Czechoslovakia' acid stamp on the base; Turriet & Bardach metal stamped Austria; post-war Glassexport bottles usually lack the stamp; Hoffmann reproductions often have a different base shape.

t.d: Mouth-blown decorative bottles sold for perfume oils, notably in the perfume shops of Khan el-Khalili.
t.tech: free blowing with a blowpipe; neck and stopper formed by hand
t.auth: Hand-made pieces vary in height and shape from bottle to bottle.
